visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal to none. Rely on 1px solid borders (#27272A) for separation and depth.
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md/rounded-lg). Keep them subtle but distinct.
visual_enhancers.effects: Avoid soft fuzzy shadows. Use flat solid dark backgrounds (#09090B, #18181B) to layer content.

layouts.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar, dark background (#000000 or #09090B), containing navigation items and the provided MARKLENCEMEDIA logo at the top.
layouts.dashboard_grid: High density but breathable grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Summary cards take 1 col. Tables and charts take 2-4 cols.
layouts.kanban_board: Horizontal scrollable flex container with fixed-width columns (e.g., w-80 or w-96). Cards inside use solid background with 1px border and hover effects.

motion.animations: Strictly minimal. No unnecessary animations, floating elements, or parallax.
motion.transitions: Use crisp `transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out` on buttons, inputs, and interactive items.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white/gold text on #000000 or #09090B meets WCAG AA standards.
accessibility.focus: Use `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E0B230] focus:outline-none` for all form elements and buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case.

images.description: MARKLENCEMEDIA official logo. Must be used in sidebar, login, dashboard, invoice PDFs. Do not modify.

media.icons: Use lucide-react (already installed). Keep icons crisp, professional, and minimal.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design Identity: Build a premium, minimal, clean, professional SaaS CRM for a digital marketing agency.
Theme: Strictly dark mode. Set body background strictly to #000000, not gray or slate.
Brand Colors: Use #E0B230 exclusively as the primary accent color (buttons, active states, key data highlights) and #FFFFFF for primary text.
Typography: Use 'Montserrat' for ALL typography. Import it and set it as the sans font family in tailwind.config.js.

Backend & CRUD: Must be a FULLY FUNCTIONAL CRM with database (SQLite/Postgres via FastAPI/SQLAlchemy) and CRUD operations. Implement the core relationship: CLIENT -> SERVICES/PROJECTS -> INVOICES -> PAYMENTS.
Features: Implement Drag and Drop Kanban for Pipeline (use a library like dnd-kit). Build fully featured tables with search/filters.
Invoice generation: Implement PDF generation for invoices containing the logo and specific CRM colors.
Avoid unnecessary animations: The UI should be snappy, direct, and professional. Not accounting software, but agency-focused.
Follow the exact semantic colors for statuses specified in the colors section.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Avoid generic, 'on distribution' AI slop. Make it look like a high-end, bespoke internal tool.
Use crisp edges via semi-transparent or subtle solid borders. Avoid muddy gray transparency.
Every interaction needs a hover state (e.g., `hover:bg-[#18181B]`) and active state with sufficient contrast.
Add `data-testid` to ALL buttons, inputs, links, forms, and key components.
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays, sticky headers, or dropdowns. Use solid `#09090B` or a heavy backdrop blur.
